bias_definition: Unbiased squared conditional bias = squared sample mean error - unbiased sample output variance/K. Signed finite-sample estimates retained. Empirical mean MSE = estimated squared bias + sample variance.
native_review: All4 six-cell boards viewed at native resolution. Mean8 reduces visible noise but fine fur/background grass and some wood irregularity stay soft. Strong bark retains coherent texture. V120/V117 changes are subtle. Mean8 is an unavailable multi-observation diagnostic, not a single-input restoration improvement.
scope: Four fixed development targets,8independent simulated noise realizations perCFA, all4CFAs, one physical ISO12800prior. Conditional-bias estimates can be negative; not clamped. Two exact synthetic Commons targets and two approximate low-noise native estimates. No source-population/seed interval, real-noise calibration, cause proof or improved-model claim. No original primary/native/GFX/mesh forwards repeated. Pure CPU publication adds0NN/noise/RAW/training.
